pitch: When you can’t pick up, people on your site still leave a name. It hits the phone you actually look at. They’re not told they’re booked. You call. We install it on the site you already have — looks like your page — and we don’t leave until you called a test lead. Seventy-five hundred, one time. We don’t answer the phone for you.
pitchEs: Cuando no puedes contestar, la gente en tu página deja nombre y teléfono. Te llega al correo o WhatsApp que sí revisas. No les decimos que ya tienen cita. Tú los llamas. Lo instalamos en la web que ya tienes, con tu mismo estilo, y no nos vamos hasta que tú llamaste un pedido de prueba. Siete mil quinientos, una vez. Nosotros no contestamos el teléfono por ti.
collect:
1. Live website URL
2. Shop name
3. Owner cell
4. Who can edit the page
5. Wix / WordPress / other (or don’t know)
6. Email or WhatsApp they actually check
7. Hours
8. Service area
9. What the visitor should leave (name, phone, what they need)
10. When we may edit
11. They create the login. We do not invent passwords. Or sit 20 min with Danny.

Visitor is never told they are booked. Text the pack to Danny 786-660-1778.

items.q: Is this recurring revenue for the shop?
items.a: One check. Don’t sell them a subscription.

items.q: Who is this for?
items.a: Local shops that already have a live website and miss work when they can’t pick up. HVAC, plumbing, electrical, garage, auto, similar. Prefer two-plus trucks or they already pay for ads.

items.q: No website?
items.a: Walk.

items.q: Site under construction? Facebook only? Instagram only? Google Business page only?
items.a: Walk. They need a live website they own.

items.q: Wix? WordPress? Squarespace? GoDaddy? Webflow? Custom?
items.a: Fine if it’s a live site someone can edit. Pack which one. If they don’t know, pack ‘don’t know.’

items.q: One truck?
items.a: Only if they already know a missed job costs more than the check. Prefer two-plus trucks or ads.

items.q: Brand new shop, no traffic yet?
items.a: This catches missed visitors. It does not invent traffic. Tell the truth. Usually walk.

items.q: Out of state? Nationwide? Canada?
items.a: We install from Miami. Travel or a remote install is Danny’s call. Don’t promise a flight.

items.q: Spanish-only shop?
items.a: Yes. Pack the language. Use the Spanish sixty seconds.

items.q: Roofing? Solar? Restoration? Property management?
items.a: If they have a live site and miss people from that site, maybe. Don’t promise leads. Run the four questions. Unsure → Danny.

items.q: Hard no?
items.a: No website. They want Google ranking. They want a redesign. They want you to answer the phone. Walk.

items.q: The four questions (hard no = walk)?
items.a: 1) Do you have a live website right now? 2) When you’re on a job or after hours, what happens to people on that site? 3) Who can edit the site? 4) Where should a new name and phone land that you will actually see?

items.q: Can I close without a URL?
items.a: You can talk. You cannot hand us air. URL cannot be blank.

items.q: Half a pack? Just a name and a maybe?
items.a: Don’t send a name with no site. Numbered 1–11.

items.q: Who creates the login?
items.a: They do. We don’t invent passwords. Or we sit twenty minutes while they set it.

items.q: They whispered their Wix password — I wrote it down.
items.a: No. They create the login. Don’t collect passwords as a trophy.

items.q: How do I send the pack?
items.a: Numbered 1–11 to Danny, 786-660-1778. Text or the email he gave you.

items.q: Can I promise tonight?
items.a: Only if we have the pack and they can create the login. Don’t promise 5pm if they can’t edit until next week.

items.q: Can I sign for VOIDD? Send a ten-page proposal?
items.a: No. You don’t sign. Don’t mill a deck. Pitch, price, collect. Print the one-page offer if they want paper.

items.q: Contract? MSA? SOW?
items.a: Danny. Don’t draft legal on WhatsApp.

items.q: When do I get paid?
items.a: After the shop pays us for an accepted install — live on their URL, test lead they saw, they called. Then 20% of collected. Fifteen hundred on seventy-five. Handshake is not a check.
Yes.

items.q: Draw? Salary? Hourly? Gas? Retainer?
items.a: No. Commission after collect. Independent / 1099.

items.q: Split if two closers worked it?
items.a: Don’t invent. One pack, Danny.

items.q: Paid on verbal? Signed but shop hasn’t paid?
items.a: No. After the shop pays VOIDD.

items.q: Friends and family? A shop Danny already knows?
items.a: Not a commission job unless Danny says invoice.

items.q: Exclusive zip codes? Exclusive HVAC in Miami-Dade?
items.a: No exclusive this week. First collected pack we can install, we install.

items.q: House accounts?
items.a: If Danny sent you the name, ask. Don’t poach a shop already in collect.

items.q: Do I get a cut of the $10k / $20k later?
items.a: Separate close, same shop. Don’t quote those as automatic. If you close the next rung, ask Danny on that check.

items.q: Can I white-label this as my agency?
items.a: No. VOIDD Labs install. You sell. We install. Your name on the commission, our name on the work unless Danny says.

items.q: W-9? Do I need an LLC to sell?
items.a: Independent closer. Danny will ask for what tax needs. Don’t invent an employment contract.

items.q: We already have a form.
items.a: Most sit in a box nobody opens, or they sound booked. This notifies the phone they check. It does not book them.

items.q: I’ll think about it. Send an email.
items.a: Fine. You’re not there to nag. If they have no site, you already walked.

items.q: My nephew does the website.
items.a: Who can edit — pack that person. If nephew won’t let anyone touch it, you don’t have an install.

items.q: Our marketing company owns the site.
items.a: Who can edit. If the answer is ‘nobody here,’ walk or get that person on the pack.

items.q: We already pay Angi $400 a lead.
items.a: This is not buying them more leads. This is people already on THEIR site when they can’t pick up. If they have no site traffic, walk.

items.q: Too expensive.
items.a: One time, existing site. Don’t discount. If a missed job is smaller than the check in their head, they’re not the shop.

items.q: Guarantee twenty jobs a week?
items.a: No. Walk rather than lie. This catches missed visitors. It does not invent traffic.

items.q: What if I pay and nobody fills it out?
items.a: We don’t invent visitors. Prefer shops with trucks or ads. Tell the truth.

items.q: I need it on every service page and the blog.
items.a: Pack which page. Don’t redesign their sitemap on the call.

items.q: Can you match our brand? We don’t want it salesy.
items.a: It looks like their page. After-hours line, leave a name. Not a countdown timer.
